visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black hair tied in twin pigtails, wearing a green t-shirt featuring a large bird graphic and light brown shorts, sits on a white floral-patterned mat. A yellow tiger plushie with a red bow is positioned on a grey circular cushion. The background consists of a light-colored wooden floor and a white perforated cabinet panel under bright, even indoor lighting. (2) A second grey circular cushion is brought into the frame by an adult's hands and placed directly on top of the tiger plushie, completely obscuring it. The girl watches intently, reaching out with her hands to touch the top cushion. The camera remains at an eye-level medium shot, capturing her facial expressions of curiosity and anticipation. (3) The girl lifts the top cushion to reveal the tiger plushie has been moved or replaced, and she crawls slightly forward on the mat to investigate the space between the cushions. She uses her hands to push the cushions aside, looking for the toy. The background remains a stable indoor environment with soft shadows and clear visibility of surrounding furniture. (4) The girl picks up a bright orange, pumpkin-shaped basket with black handles and begins to interact with it while sitting on the mat. She attempts to place the yellow tiger plushie inside the orange basket, adjusting its position with her small hands. Her facial expressions shift from focused concentration to a slight smile as she successfully tucks the toy into the basket. (5) The scene transitions to a final graphic screen with a solid pink background. A cartoon illustration of a girl with pigtails in a circular frame appears in the center, accompanied by white capitalized text. The lighting is flat and the composition is centered, marking the conclusion of the video sequence.
